I have farmed this 0.08-hectare sorghum plot for over forty years, and because I own it, I spread manure from my animals every season to keep the soil strong. Last year I bought three small mudus of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer in town — not a full bag, because one bag is too much money for this small plot — and my yield was better than before, so I will do the same this season. I will use my own seed that I kept from last year; I do not buy improved seed because it costs too much. I will not spray any chemicals or irrigate, and my wife and I will work this plot for about 15 days this season because I cannot afford to hire anyone.
